module: Flowgraph node "Rally Route After Road Section" (category once_instant, tag rally). Routes the flow after a road section according to the current mission of the rally loop schedule: toServiceIn if rm:getCurrentMissionId() is 'serviceIn', otherwise toSpecialStage. If there is no current mission, a warning is logged and no output is activated.

workOnce.desc: Activates toServiceIn or toSpecialStage according to the id of the current mission.
